changed_in.5.4: A second argument names which of the userdata's values to read, counting from `1` and defaulting to the first, and a second value of `true` comes back when the userdata really has a value at that position — so a position holding `nil` can be told from one that is not there. Earlier a full userdata carries exactly one value, anything written after the userdata is ignored, and one value is all this call ever answers with.
